name: Personal agent current work and next actions
summary: Current attention uses one bounded work snapshot per project and request. A single agent recovers owned tasks with owner-filtered pages when that snapshot is incomplete; owner lists reuse bounded rows. Snapshot, own-task and action truncation flags are distinct; incomplete snapshot counts are lower bounds. Only latest checkpoint blockers/dependencies mark undelivered work blocked; delivered review state takes precedence. Review/checkpoint errors name an operator action and error summary; request IDs are capped at20. Current-assignee comments stay quiet and other authors wake; unattributed native title/description edits may stay quiet. Setup instructions say to record a blocker when an answer is needed to proceed. Existing independent review recommendations, counts and action order are retained. Action kind names are the contract; numeric priorities are relative hints. This remains an unaccepted proposal; review, integration and verification are separate.
